_comment: PLANNED configuration — no live WooCommerce (uipath-automattic-woocommerce) connection exists in this tenant (uip is connections list returns none across all folders, and the connector itself is Active:No/CatalogActive:No in uip is connectors list). Run `uip maestro flow node configure` with real values once a connection is available; this node has NOT been configured on the .flow and will not pass flow validate until then.

_fieldNotes.attribute: Parent reference field (objectName: '/attributes'). Must be set for 'attribute_term' to become visible per its fieldActions show/hide rule keyed on this field.
_fieldNotes.attribute_term: The attribute-term dropdown field (displayName 'Attribute terms'). design.loadByDefault=false, so its options are NOT preloaded when the activity form opens — the dropdown resolves its option list on demand (reference lookup: attributes::terms via /attributes/terms?attribute_ID={attribute}), i.e. only when the caller opens/interacts with it. This is the field the task asked to configure. Resolve the real term id at authoring time via: uip is resources run list uipath-automattic-woocommerce 'attributes/terms?attribute_ID=<ATTRIBUTE_ID>' --connection-id <id>
